title: Binance OMS Toolkit Tier Structure & Benefit System
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To qualify for rebates of up to 50% as outlined in the table below, Binance Link clients must meet the required threshold for both average monthly trading volume and the average number of active trading users over a quarterly period.  If a Binance Link client does not meet the minimum requirement(s) for the Bronze tier during a given quarter, the Binance Link client will be disqualified from the program and will no longer be eligible to receive rebates. Binance OMS Toolkit Tier Structure Requirements Bronze Silver Gold Average monthly trading volume in a quarter Spot volume ≥ 40,000 USDT or Futures volume ≥ 80,000 USDT Spot volume ≥ 40,000,000 USDT or Futures volume ≥ 200,000,000 USDT Spot volume ≥ 200,000,000 USDT or Futures volume ≥ 1,000,000,000 USDT Average number of monthly trading users in a quarter Spot users ≥ 10 or Futures users ≥ 5 Spot users ≥ 40 or Futures users ≥ 20 Spot users ≥ 200 or Futures users ≥ 100 Benefit System Bronze Silver Gold Spot OMS Toolkit Rebate 40% 45% 50% Futures OMS Toolkit Rebate 30% 30% 30% Notes: The existing tiers for Binance Link clients, which are based on the average monthly trading volume in a quarter and the average number of monthly trading users in a quarter, will be automatically adjusted.  Please note that Binance Link clients will be eligible to receive spot OMS toolkit rebates from spot trades completed by their regular and VIP 1-2 users only. On top of that, Binance Link clients will only receive futures OMS toolkit rebates from USDⓈ-M futures trades and COIN-M futures trades completed by their regular and VIP 1-2 users.  Tiers and the corresponding benefits will be adjusted at the beginning of each quarter. Each Binance Link client will receive the update email from Binance. Newly onboarded Binance Link clients will have a fixed rebate period of three months, during which they will not participate in tier review. All Binance Link clients are prohibited from distributing any spot/futures OMS toolkit rebates to their users. Binance reserves the right to cancel or amend reward(s), as well as to disqualify Binance Link clients, if it determines in its sole and absolute discretion that Binance Link clients are acting fraudulently or not in accordance with any applicable terms and conditions. Users may reach out to  link@binance.com  for any enquiries. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-05-12
